output_assertion.parameter_range: Characteristic-zero number fields and good finite places; the coefficient prime differs from the residue characteristic.
output_assertion.uniformity: Qualitative finite exclusions only; no bound or replacement of either controlled field or exceptional set.
output_assertion.constants: No numerical conductor, degree or height estimate is asserted.
output_assertion.normalizations: Use actual geometric torsion and its transition maps. Enlarge the finite excluded set by primes ramified in F/Q.
output_assertion.exceptional_cases: No good reduction at the coefficient prime is inferred; bad or ramified places are excluded.
output_assertion.limit_order: Good model then finite etale torsion then strict henselian splitting then trivial inertia; finally pass to the r_5 summand and Q.

connecting_derivation.explanation: For each5-power order, splitting over the strict henselization says the generic torsion is defined over the maximal unramified extension. Thus inertia fixes every level and the inverse limit. The same finite-etale argument works for either original surface and uses no comparison Frobenius choice. At rational primes unramified in F, inertia in G_Q lies in G_F, where rho_5 is the actual Tate action. A direct summand is unramified. Excluding5, bad places and ramified primes proves finite ramification.

adverse_cases.reason: No good reduction at the coefficient prime is inferred; bad or ramified places are excluded.
